name: Create User - Standard User
purpose: Developer test fixture. Creates a standard test User with hard-coded name, email and SMTP settings by calling karbon_kontroller Create User; returns the result or the error. Effect owner would be server-domain (user creation).
open_question: Hard-coded SMTP server, port and username for a test user (no password in this script). Used by the Create Note/Task test scripts.

name: Create Note - Standard Note
purpose: Developer test fixture. Creates a test Note through karbon_kontroller Create Note with fixed subject and message and today's date and time; returns the result. Effect owner would be server-domain.
open_question: $CreatorId and $RegardingId are never set in this script; a caller must set them as script-level variables or the note is created without creator and regarding ids.

name: Create Task - Standard Task
purpose: Developer test fixture. Creates a test Task through karbon_kontroller Create Task, assigned to a random User party picked with SQL.GetRandomFieldValue, due today; returns the result. Effect owner would be server-domain.
open_question: Random party choice means the test is not repeatable. SQL.GetRandomFieldValue is a custom function (probably ExecuteSQL).
